data_description.password: Leave blank to keep the saved password. Enter a new password after changing it in the Sunsynk or Deye portal.
data_description.create_dashboard: Opt in to creating a Lovelace dashboard, registering the bundled card resource, and updating that dashboard on each integration reload. Disabled by default.
data_description.admin_only_control: When ticked, the Sunsynk control actions (force charge/discharge, work mode, virtual slots) can only be run by Home Assistant administrators. Automations and scripts are unaffected. Only administrators can change this setting.
data_description.latitude: Optional — defaults to your HA home location
data_description.longitude: Optional — defaults to your HA home location
data_description.panel_kwp: Total installed panel capacity in kilowatt-peak. Leave blank to disable solar forecast.
data_description.price_entity: Any sensor reporting electricity price (e.g. Octopus Agile, NordPool, Tibber). Leave blank to disable tariff management.
data_description.export_price_entity: Drives discharge/sell decisions instead of the import price above — for tariffs where import and export rates aren't linked (e.g. Octopus Intelligent Go + Outgoing). Leave blank to use the import price for both.
data_description.cheap_threshold: When price ≤ this value, charge the battery. Leave blank to disable cheap-rate charging.
data_description.cheap_charge_current: Battery charge current during cheap period (e.g. 100 A).
data_description.normal_charge_current: Charge current restored when cheap period ends.
data_description.cheap_target_soc: Charging stops automatically once battery reaches this SOC. Default 100.
data_description.expensive_threshold: When price ≥ this value, discharge the battery (sell to grid). Leave blank to disable.
data_description.peak_discharge_current: Battery discharge current during expensive period (e.g. 100 A).
data_description.normal_discharge_current: Discharge current restored when expensive period ends.
data_description.discharge_min_soc: Discharging stops automatically when battery reaches this SOC. Default 10.
data_description.max_export_power: Optional. The most a selling slot may put out, for the whole system, e.g. your G99/G100 limit (11000 for 11 kW). In a parallel system enter the total: it is shared between the inverters. Your system now: {export_inverters} inverter(s) per group, so the saved value is {export_share} W per inverter. It limits the sell power of slots set by the Virtual Slot Scheduler, including Tariff Manager discharges. It does not limit solar export: for that, set the inverter's own Max Sell Power. Leave blank for no limit here.
data_description.tariff_start_hour: Hour of day (0–23) when tariff management activates. Leave blank for always-on.
data_description.tariff_end_hour: Hour of day (0–23) when tariff management deactivates. Can wrap midnight (e.g. start 22, end 6). The same start and end hour (e.g. 0 and 0) means all day.
data_description.price_stale_check: Off by default. When on, Tariff Manager stops any active charge or discharge if the import price sensor hasn't reported for longer than Price data max age. Leave it off if your price stays the same for long periods or is set by a helper.
data_description.tariff_test_mode: When on, Tariff Manager decides as usual and shows it in Tariff Mode, its notifications and the log, but sends nothing to the inverter, and the Virtual Slot Scheduler ignores it. Use it to check your settings safely.
data_description.price_max_age: Only used when “Stop when price data looks out of date” is on. If the import price sensor hasn't reported within this many minutes, any active charge/discharge mode is stopped. A separate export price sensor is never age-checked. Default 90.

error.invalid_auth: Invalid credentials. Check your Sunsynk email and password.
error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to the Sunsynk API. Check API server and internet connection.
error.already_configured: This Sunsynk account is already configured.
error.invalid_serials: Invalid serial number(s). Enter at least one serial.
error.invalid_forecast_config: Solar forecast requires valid latitude, longitude and panel kWp (all numeric, kWp > 0).
error.invalid_tariff_config: Tariff configuration error. Cheap charging needs threshold + charge current + normal current (all three). Discharge needs threshold + peak current + normal current (all three).
error.charge_current_above_limit: Too high: your system charges the battery at no more than {charge_max} A ({charge_limits}). A higher value has no effect.
error.discharge_current_above_limit: Too high: your system discharges the battery at no more than {discharge_max} A ({discharge_limits}). A higher value has no effect.
error.invalid_export_power: Maximum export power must be a whole number of watts between 1 and 30000.

auth_failed.title: Sunsynk authentication failed
auth_failed.description: The Sunsynk cloud API rejected the credentials. Go to **Settings → Devices & Services → Sunsynk → Configure** and enter the new password.

inverter_offline.title: Inverter {serial} is offline
inverter_offline.description: Data for inverter **{serial}** could not be fetched. Check that the inverter dongle is connected and the Sunsynk app shows live data.

setting_write_mismatch.title: Setting {setting_key} did not apply on {serial}
setting_write_mismatch.description: We told inverter **{serial}** to set **{setting_key}** to `{expected}`, but reading it back reports `{actual}`. The inverter or dongle may have rejected the value — check it directly in the Sunsynk app. This will clear automatically once a write to this setting is confirmed.
